whenToUse: The confirmation step of a launch waitlist: the person's place in line and a link that moves them up.
Invite or give-a-month-get-a-month programmes where people share a personal link and see progress toward a reward.
avoidWhen: There is no real queue or referral programme — show a plain confirmation (empty-state or alert).
Showing invented queue numbers or signup counts.
a11y: A labelled region; the big queue number is aria-hidden and a polite live sentence ("You are number 412 in line") is re-announced when it changes.
The link is a read-only labelled field; the copy result is announced in a status region and a failed copy shows a visible hint.
